column3: Kuroneko's Ability
Well, well... But you know...
Kuroneko-shi was indeed truly amazing.
Spectators even cheered for her a few times.
However... The partner was really bad.
The "partner" in question is obviously her teammate...
It's not particularly your fault.
No, I feel very sorry about it.
In the finals too, Kuroneko was practically unharmed.
I wouldn't get onto her level even if I practiced my whole life.
And it's not like I'd go that far to master just one game anyway.
As I thought, I can't keep up with you.
Hmm? What's wrong?
...Kuroneko?
It's nothing.
Nothing... Then why's she making such a face?
She's kinda flustered...
I have to do something to avoid where this discussion is going.
A topic likely to redirect the conversation would be...
S-Still, I'm happy for you! That exclusive prize is quite rare, isn't it?
...If you want it, I can give it to you.
Hey hey, are you really okay with that? You wanted it, right?
Your bound soul has already merged with my body.
Huh?
I don't get it. Soul? Merged with your body? What's with that?
What's wrong? You don't accept it?
No, no. I can't accept it. Even though you're disappointed by the result, you still won it.
Is that so?
Furthermore, it would become Kirino's if I did take it.
...Because you're a siscon?
Obviously not.
...Heh, then just accept it graciously.
Nope, it's yours.
Walking beside Kuroneko...
Kirino was fiddling with her phone while grumbling.
And right beside was Saori consoling Kirino with a smirk.
You know...
Is there anything else?
In the end, why did you participate in the tournament? You were clearly quarreling with Kirino earlier.
...Indeed, I wonder why.
You wonder why...? You...
As improbable as it is, it could be that you piqued my interest.
I felt that taking part in this tournament with you could be rather interesting...
That... You mean--
And you? Why did you take part in this tournament?
Huh? Because without me, you all wouldn't have been able to form two teams.
I'm not referring to that, these goods clearly have no significance to you... To begin with, you weren't very interested in this either, right?
Well, yeah, but I was being relied on.
...Good grief. Should I call you softhearted or just an idiot?
What do you mean by that?
You're really a siscon in the end.
Gah!! You're still saying that?! I told you I'm not!
Hehe, it's a joke, just a joke.
I am at a loss for words.
What's wrong, Kuroneko?
Nothing...
Nothing you say...
She really must be bitter about this loss...
'Cause she has such great pride...
I'm sorry, I ended up dragging you down...
My magical power simply wasn't enough.
Even if you say so...
Please just stop. To hear your apologies is an unneeded disgrace.
I see...
This is difficult... I don't know what to say.
I'm sorry.
...You're persistent.
Thank you.
...Me too, I've been greatly entertained.
Thanks... Senpai.
